body:
The reported C# failure was a macOS hosted-runner acquisition outage: the job never executed a step. This PR also fixes independent checks that could report success while dropping link errors, accepting incomplete CodeQL extraction, ignoring failed prerequisites, or skipping committed logs during secrets scanning.

Fixes #165

- Use an available C# macOS runner and add bounded recovery only for confirmed runner-acquisition failures. Ordinary test failures remain failures.
- Validate every workflow prerequisite, SARIF invocation/diagnostic, maintained NuGet graph and Cargo warning. Preserve reports on failure and add default-off verbose diagnostics.
- Detect lockfile/helper-only changes, full merges on main and source moves into excluded folders; fail on missing Git evidence or output writes while preserving per-commit PR detection.
- Fix adjacent-link parsing, bound transient retries, preserve archive fallback, and fail on missing or malformed evidence.
- Repair JavaScript/C# CodeQL extraction and stale overlay diagnostics; keep the full client conformance coverage and all native OS matrices.
- Add complete maintained JavaScript/Python formatting, lint/type checks and local hooks; audit every Cargo/npm/NuGet/Python dependency set. Refresh outdated dependencies and prepare Rust/C# patch releases through existing changesets.
- Authenticate before main release builds, retain PR advisory behavior, cancel superseded read-only checks, and serialize release/deployment writers.

The [audit and requirements matrix](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-165-a5206aa5b4c0/dev/log/issues/165/pulls/166/analysis/AUDIT.md) contains root causes, alternatives and executed plans for every requirement and all seventeen best-practice principles. The [evidence index](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-165-a5206aa5b4c0/dev/log/issues/165/pulls/166/README.md) links 93 collected runs, full available logs/annotations, the event timeline, immutable snapshots of four templates, and a comparison of all 1,063 tree entries.

Reproduction and validation:

- `node experiments/issue-165/reproduce-template-gaps.mjs` runs the original template helpers and repaired implementations on identical inputs: two adjacent broken links previously became one, and extraction-error SARIF previously passed.
- `node experiments/issue-165/reproduce-ignored-secret.mjs` verifies that both ignored plain logs and compressed logs are scanned and reject a synthetic secret.
- 282 local helper/repository tests plus five Rust detector tests pass; all 81 maintained JavaScript and 16 Python files pass formatting/lint, and both runtime CI helpers pass strict mypy.
- `python experiments/issue-165/reproduce-change-detection.py` proves the original/fixed Rust lock/helper flags and failed Git/output exit statuses with a focused one-job build.
- All ten workflows passed on `fd17aa4`, `8f24ffd` and `5db14dd`, including the additional change-detection fixes. The final follow-up runs full CodeQL queries directly to avoid the compare API’s 300-file limit; validation of `917b6ef` passes in all ten workflows below. Full native Rust/.NET/Wasm builds, fresh-merge checks, security scans and Node/Bun/Deno backend conformance run in CI.

Shared defects were reported with reproductions, workarounds and code suggestions: [Rust template #228](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/228), [C# template #98](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/98), [JS template #286](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/286), [Python template #137](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/137), [CodeQL #23036](https://github.com/github/codeql/issues/23036), [CodeQL #23037](https://github.com/github/codeql/issues/23037), [CodeQL Action #4307](https://github.com/github/codeql-action/issues/4307), and [CodeQL Action #4308](https://github.com/github/codeql-action/issues/4308).

The recovery trigger becomes active after the workflow reaches main; its classification and retry bounds are tested offline before merge. Registry probes do not publish packages, and NuGet authentication is explicitly distinguished from package push authorization, which the real publication must enforce. The original unexplained Rust upload failure remains documented with the available evidence and opt-in diagnostics; subsequent fresh Rust analyses pass.

Known external diagnostics are fully inventoried in the [final verification record](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-165-a5206aa5b4c0/dev/log/issues/165/pulls/166/analysis/final-verification.md). On final head `917b6ef`, GitHub’s [CodeQL comparison summary](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/runs/127647402772) is neutral only because of the obsolete, pre-existing C# `autobuild` baseline configuration; all five current categories are present and pass. The earlier stale pending-category summary is reported upstream, with the final observation added to that report. Dependency Review’s 23 low OpenSSF project-practice scores remain visible, while vulnerability audits pass. Historical security configurations and warning thresholds are preserved.

Final validation on `917b6efec0eceaffb90be842b474acc0edf2f712` (all runs created after this commit):

| Workflow | Passing run |
|---|---|
| Broken Link Checker | [42142575111](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575111) |
| C# CI/CD Pipeline | [42142575137](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575137) |
| DeepClient CI | [42142575090](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575090) |
| Dependencies | [42142575107](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575107) |
| Docs | [42142575165](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575165) |
| JS client CI | [42142575168](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575168) |
| Rust CI/CD Pipeline | [42142575218](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575218) |
| Security | [42142575251](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575251) |
| WebAssembly CI | [42142575301](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575301) |
| Workflows | [42142575232](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/42142575232) |

Final audit: main is an ancestor, all changes are committed and pushed, the working tree is clean, and issue/PR comments and reviews contain no outstanding requested changes. The evidence cutoff preserves 93 committed run records; the ten final-head logs, metadata and paginated annotations are also collected locally under `dev/log/issues/165/pulls/166/verification/final/`, with permanent run links above.
title: fix(ci): eliminate hidden failures and harden all pipelines
